units.source_text: 薰大将回三条院后，次日一早起身。

en.t: After General Kaoru returned to Sanjo Palace, he rose early the next morning.

units.source_text: 看看夫人二公主的相貌，觉得非常姣美。

en.t: Looking at the features of his wife, the Second Princess, he thought she was very beautiful.

units.source_text: 但他想：“虽说大公主未必胜于这二公主，然而仔细看来，毕竟不同，

en.t: But he thought, "Although the Elder Princess may not necessarily surpass this Second Princess, when one looks closely, they are different after all,

units.source_text: 大公主异常高雅，光艳照人，其美实在不可言喻！

en.t: the Elder Princess is extraordinarily refined, radiant enough to dazzle anyone, and her beauty truly cannot be put into words!

units.source_text: 但这也许是我有成见之故，或者时地不同之故吧。”

en.t: But perhaps this is because I am biased, or because the time and place were different."

units.source_text: 便对二公主说：“天气热得很呢。

en.t: Then he said to the Second Princess, "The weather is terribly hot.

units.source_text: 你换一件薄一点的衣服吧。

en.t: You should change into something a little lighter.

units.source_text: 女子的衣服须时时更新，才能显出各季节的风趣。”

en.t: A woman's clothing must be changed from time to time to bring out the charm of each season."

units.source_text: 又对侍女说：“到皇后那里去，叫大弍替公主缝一件轻罗单衫。”

en.t: He also said to a maid, "Go to the Empress and ask Daini to sew a light gauze unlined robe for the Princess."

units.source_text: 众侍女想：“我们公主青春美貌，大将要仔细欣赏。”

en.t: The maids all thought, "Our Princess is young and beautiful, and the General means to admire her closely."

units.source_text: 大家很高兴。

en.t: They were all very pleased.

units.source_text: 薰大将照例到佛堂诵经，然后回到自己室中休息。

en.t: As usual, General Kaoru went to the Buddhist hall to recite sutras, then returned to his own room to rest.

units.source_text: 中午来到二公主房中，看见刚才吩咐侍女去要的轻罗单衫已经挂在帷屏上了。

en.t: At noon he came to the Second Princess's room and saw that the light gauze robe he had just ordered the maid to fetch was already hanging on the curtain screen.

units.source_text: 他对二公主说：“你为什么不穿？

en.t: He said to the Second Princess, "Why are you not wearing it?

units.source_text: 人多的时候，穿半透明的衣服似乎放肆，但现在无妨。”

en.t: When many people are present, wearing a translucent garment may seem immodest, but now there is no harm."

units.source_text: 便亲手替她换衣。

en.t: Then he changed her clothes with his own hands.

units.source_text: 裙子也同昨日大公主所穿的一样，是红色的。

en.t: Her skirt, like the one the Elder Princess had worn the day before, was red.

units.source_text: 二公主头发很浓密，长长地下垂，其美也不逊于大公主。

en.t: The Second Princess's hair was very thick and hung down long, and her beauty was not inferior to the Elder Princess's.

units.source_text: 然而各有特色，并不完全相同。

en.t: Yet each had her own character, and they were not entirely alike.

units.source_text: 他命人拿些冰来，叫众侍女把它割碎，拿一块送给二公主。

en.t: He ordered someone to bring some ice, had the maids cut it into pieces, and offered one piece to the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 如此模仿，自己心中也觉得可笑。

en.t: Imitating things in this way, he found it amusing even in his own heart.

units.source_text: 他想：“世人有把所爱的人写入画中、借看画以慰情者。

en.t: He thought, "There are people in the world who paint the one they love into a picture and console their feelings by looking at it.

units.source_text: 何况她是大公主的妹妹，更宜于替我慰情。”

en.t: Since she is the Elder Princess's younger sister, she should be even more suited to comfort my heart."

units.source_text: 但他又想：“如果昨日我也能像今天一样参与其间，任意欣赏大公主……”

en.t: But then he thought, "If only yesterday I too could have joined in as I did today and admired the Elder Princess as much as I wished..."

units.source_text: 这么一想，不觉叹息一声。

en.t: Thinking this, he could not help letting out a sigh.

units.source_text: 便问二公主：“你近来写信给大公主么？”

en.t: Then he asked the Second Princess, "Have you written to the Elder Princess lately?"

units.source_text: 二公主答道：“没有。

en.t: The Second Princess answered, "No.

units.source_text: 在宫中时，父皇叫我写，我就写给她。

en.t: When I was in the palace, if my father told me to write, I would write to her.

units.source_text: 但此后长久不写了。”

en.t: But since then I have not written for a long time."

units.source_text: 薰大将说：“你嫁给了臣下，所以大公主不写信给你，真是遗憾。

en.t: General Kaoru said, "It is truly regrettable that the Elder Princess does not write to you because you have married a subject.

units.source_text: 你赶快去见母后，向她诉说：你怨恨大公主。”

en.t: Go quickly to see your mother, the Empress, and tell her that you resent the Elder Princess."

units.source_text: 二公主说：“怎么可以怨恨呢？

en.t: The Second Princess said, "How could I resent her?

units.source_text: 我不去说。”

en.t: I will not go and say that."

units.source_text: 薰大将说：“那么你可对母后说：大姐为了我是臣下，看我不起，所以我也不写信给她。”

en.t: General Kaoru said, "Then you may tell your mother, the Empress, that your elder sister looks down on you because I am a subject, and so you will not write to her either."
